items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story involving 'Catcher' (Sandtop) and 'Hop', but does not state a personal relationship with Catcher himself, only that he was aware of him in the context of the story.

ctx.x: Catcher. Great catcher. He was around the time of Frank Duncan and Gibson, you know, and (Sharing and Shock) and those kind of people. So, Sandtop must have weighed around, I would say, 250. No fat, just a big cat. So Hop was (phasing) him so much, he came around and sat down. So, he said, I told you, man, you're talking about you know baseball and those cats and I played baseball. I know ... And I said, Well, Sandtop, please excuse me, I didn't know your name. So it got time to go so Hop says, Where's my hat? He…
Was it a brand new hat?
